name: Dog-Crate End Table
pitch: A dog crate that looks like furniture: tabletop, slatted door, ventilated sides, lift-out washable trays, sized to your dog.

stages.title: Cut the sheets
stages.detail: Fit-test coupon first (slot = tab + 0.1 mm); cut 2 sheet(s): 62 m of path with 30 rounded vent/slat openings. Use cabinet-grade ply with NAUF/CARB2 glue (no MDF - dogs chew it and moisture swells it). Inside-out order, air assist on.

stages.title: Remove char, sand, round every edge
stages.detail: Brush the char off, 120 then 180 then 220 grit. Hand-round ALL edges, slot ends and the inside of the door opening (about 3 mm) - no splinters or sharp arrises where a dog can rub. Sand the tab ends flush later.

stages.title: Dry fit
stages.detail: Stand SIDE-L/R, slide in FLOOR, FRONT and BACK, then drop TOP over every tab. Check the DOOR sits in its opening with about 2 mm all round and the trays drop in.

stages.title: Pre-finish (pet-safe)
stages.detail: Finish every part before glue-up with a cured pet-safe finish (water-based poly or food-safe hardwax oil, 2-3 coats); let it cure fully (3-7 days is best) before a dog goes in. Mask tabs and slots.

stages.title: Glue-up (Titebond III)
stages.detail: Glue FLOOR, FRONT and BACK into SIDE-L, add SIDE-R, then seat TOP on all tabs. Clamp across the width and check it is square. Wipe squeeze-out; no glue on the door or trays.

stages.title: Screws from the outside only
stages.detail: 12 #8 x 1-1/2 in screws (3.0 mm pilots pre-cut) through the side faces into the floor, front and back edges. Nothing protrudes inside the crate. Countersink and plug.

stages.title: Hang the door
stages.detail: Two 3 in surface-mount flush hinges on the right: pre-drill 2.5 mm for the hinge screws, set the door with 2 mm gaps (never wider than 4 mm - paw safety). Fit a dog-proof barrel bolt on the door and drop its pin through the 9 mm hole in the header.

stages.title: Sand tab ends and final finish
stages.detail: Sand the tab ends on the tabletop flush, final coat on the top (wipe-clean, heat/water resistant poly), edge-seal the cut ends.

stages.title: Pad, test, pack
stages.detail: Lay a washable pad on the trays. Shake test, then flat-pack: parts up to 900 x 600 mm in one box with corner guards; include hinge and bolt hardware and the care and safety sheet.

materials.sheet: 18 mm (3/4 in) birch cabinet plywood (NAUF/CARB2 glue), 4 x 8 ft x 2 - no MDF

hardware.note: pin goes in the 9 mm header hole

materials.finish: pet-safe water-based poly or food-safe hardwax oil, 3 coats (about $18)

safety: Animal safety (design intent, NOT certified): all openings <= 38 mm, every slot end rounded, door gap about 2 mm, no screws or hinge hardware inside, tabs flush.
Use a dog-proof latch and test with the dog supervised; this is a rest crate, not a restraint or vehicle crate.
Pet-safe cured finish only; no MDF, no chemical stains inside; ventilation about 30 slotted openings.
Interior 824 x 484 x 536 mm: check the dog's shoulder height + 50 mm, nose-to-tail length + 80 mm before ordering; the default suits a dog up to about 18 kg.
Tabletop rating target 25 kg of objects (UNVERIFIED); the crate floor target 40 kg dog (UNVERIFIED).

profit.labels: ESTIMATES AND ASSUMPTIONS ONLY - not quotes, not guaranteed
profit.assumptions: All dollar figures are planning ESTIMATES / ASSUMPTIONS, not quotes, not guaranteed. Sheet prices: 4x8 ft 18 mm birch plywood $70-110, basic plywood $55-75 (assumption). Machine feed 100-200 mm/min is an UNVERIFIED estimate (ACMER publishes no 18 mm ply feed rate). Machine wear/electricity $1.70 per machine-hour (assumption). Labor valued at $25/h for the "after labor" line only. Marketplace fees 10% (assumption, e.g. Etsy-style).
profit.note_machine_time: At 100-200 mm/min the laser path alone is 5.2-10.3 machine hours per unit; machine time, not material, is the bottleneck. Verify the real feed on scrap before quoting.

unverified: Not tested with an animal; rating and chew resistance unknown.
Hinge and bolt positions are guidance; screw holes for hinges are drilled by hand.
Laser feed 100-200 mm/min is an estimate.
Height default is 700 mm (spec said ~650): the extra 50 mm keeps a 90 mm robot-vac plinth and a 536 mm interior.
Visible tab ends on the tabletop (sand flush or cover).
